review.tagline: eve and Nuxt personal agent with Slack, GitHub, Linear and per-user memory
review.summary: A Nuxt app plus an eve agent runtime: Better Auth email login, web chat with threads that eve persists, Slack DMs and mentions linked to the same user, GitHub tools with durable approval on writes, Linear via Vercel Connect MCP, and a bounded per-user memory document in Vercel Blob. Postgres via Drizzle holds users and links; on Vercel it deploys as two services. For developers building a single-user or small-team assistant on eve.
review.audience: Developers building a personal or small-team assistant on eve
strengths: Memory is per authenticated principal, recalled before every turn and after compaction
Slack identity links to the web profile so context follows the user
Write actions on GitHub gate on durable approvals
CI workflow, CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md present
weaknesses: Needs Vercel Connect for Slack and Linear; self-hosting those integrations is on you
No model provider named in the README; configured through eve
No tests listed; CI covers typecheck and build
